question: Explain whether our CCC problem is driven more by slow customers, excess inventory, or supplier payment timing.

sql_generation.sql:
WITH ccc_components AS (
  SELECT
    'DSO (Days Sales Outstanding)' AS component,
    SUM(pa.days_to_pay * pa.amount_applied) / SUM(pa.amount_applied) AS days
  FROM mro_distributor.ar_payment_application pa
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'DIO (Days Inventory Outstanding)' AS component,
    (SELECT AVG(daily_value) FROM (
       SELECT snap.snapshot_date_key, SUM(snap.value_on_hand) AS daily_value
       FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap
       GROUP BY snap.snapshot_date_key))
    /
    (SELECT SUM(sol.ext_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT sol.order_date_key)
     FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol) AS days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'DPO (Days Payable Outstanding)' AS component,
    -(SUM(bp.days_to_pay * bp.amount_paid) / SUM(bp.amount_paid))
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_bill_payment bp
)
SELECT
  component,
  days,
  ROUND(days / (SELECT ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'DSO (Days Sales Outstanding)' THEN days
                                     WHEN component = 'DPO (Days Payable Outstanding)' THEN days
                                     ELSE days END)
                      - SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'DPO (Days Payable Outstanding)' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END))
                FROM ccc_components) * 100, 1) AS pct_of_ccc
FROM ccc_components
ORDER BY ABS(days) DESC;

WITH velocity AS (
  SELECT ff.item_key, SUM(ff.qty_shipped) AS units
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff
  GROUP BY ff.item_key
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT quantile_cont(units, 0.2) AS q FROM velocity
),
item_supplier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT po.item_key, po.supplier_key
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    v.item_key,
    CASE WHEN v.units <= cutoff.q THEN 'Slow-Moving' ELSE 'Fast-Moving' END AS movement_class,
    s.reliability_tier,
    po.late_days
  FROM velocity v, cutoff
  JOIN item_supplier m ON v.item_key = m.item_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_supplier s ON m.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po ON m.item_key = po.item_key AND m.supplier_key = po.supplier_key
)
SELECT 
  movement_class,
  reliability_tier,
  COUNT(*) AS po_count,
  AVG(late_days) AS avg_supplier_lateness_days,
  STDDEV(late_days) AS stddev_lateness
FROM classified
GROUP BY movement_class, reliability_tier
ORDER BY movement_class DESC, reliability_tier;

WITH otif_analysis AS (
  SELECT

    CASE WHEN ff.ship_date_key IS NULL THEN 'never_shipped'
         WHEN ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key AND ff.qty_shipped < sol.qty_ordered THEN 'both'
         WHEN ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key THEN 'late_only'
         WHEN ff.qty_shipped < sol.qty_ordered THEN 'short_only'
         ELSE 'otif' END AS miss_type,
    ff.item_key,
    ff.so_line_key
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol
  LEFT JOIN mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff USING (so_line_key)
),
miss_counts AS (
  SELECT
    miss_type,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otif_analysis) AS pct_of_total
  FROM otif_analysis
  WHERE miss_type != 'otif'
  GROUP BY miss_type
),
late_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    s.supplier_name,
    s.reliability_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS late_miss_lines
  FROM otif_analysis oa
  JOIN mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff ON oa.so_line_key = ff.so_line_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_item di USING (item_key)
  JOIN mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po ON di.item_key = po.item_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_supplier s USING (supplier_key)

  GROUP BY s.supplier_name, s.reliability_tier
  ORDER BY late_miss_lines DESC
)
SELECT

  mc.pct_of_total,
  ls.supplier_name,
  ls.reliability_tier,
  ls.late_miss_lines
FROM miss_counts mc
LEFT JOIN late_suppliers ls ON 1=1
ORDER BY mc.pct_of_total DESC, ls.late_miss_lines DESC;
